title: Grande Burrito
summary: A motion-led restaurant site that gives Grande Burrito's identity and frequently changing menu a dedicated digital home.
intro: The concept translates Grande Burrito's logo and printed-menu style into a motion-led SvelteKit site with a practical Sanity editing system.

heroImage.alt: Grande Burrito landing hero with a foil-wrapped burrito positioned over the oversized Grande wordmark

role: Independent research · Digital design · Content system · Engineering

designSystem.name: Grande Burrito Sign & Sheet System
designSystem.summary: A sign-led, menu-sheet-inspired system that keeps restaurant decisions clear and resilient.

principles.name: The sign is the anchor, not wallpaper
principles.description: Brand cues establish identity without competing with operational information.

principles.name: Operational facts come first
principles.description: Hours, menu, phone, and directions remain useful through degraded states.

principles.name: Borrow the menu's rhythm, improve its scan
principles.description: Printed-menu character is translated into accessible digital hierarchy.

principles.name: Build resilience into the default
principles.description: Accessibility, responsive content, and service failure are first-class states.

typography.description: A self-hosted condensed face reserved for the sign-derived mark.
Brings printed-menu character to food-led headings.
Keeps hours, prices, actions, and operational copy fast to scan.

components.name: BrandMark
components.description: A responsive reconstruction anchors the identity while its provisional provenance stays explicit.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description: Menu rows preserve pricing and availability detail without recreating the printed menu’s density.

components.name: HoursStatus
components.description: Current status, next transition, today’s hours, and exceptions stay answerable together.

componentSnapshot.alt: Grande Burrito design-system specimens showing the BrandMark, an available MenuItem, and the current HoursStatus panel in the viewer’s system theme
componentSnapshot.caption: BrandMark, MenuItem, and HoursStatus captured from the Grande Burrito system specimen.

productProof.title: Printed-menu rhythm becomes a scannable system
productProof.description: Food categories, descriptions, and prices use a consistent editorial hierarchy that keeps a long made-to-order menu easy to scan.

image.alt: Grande Burrito menu showing typographic hierarchy across starters, burritos, descriptions, and prices

accessibility.title: Operational information survives degraded states
accessibility.description: The sign pair measures about 5.33:1, actions meet the 44px target, focus remains visible in forced colors, and status never relies on color alone.

internalNotes: Self-initiated concept; not commissioned, reviewed, or approved by Grande Burrito. The current hero burrito is an AI-generated placeholder and must not be described as real restaurant photography. Before presenting: simplify the admin, replace hero imagery with original food photography, consider more motion, and add menu printing.
